gaps: Transaction and address history, spending links and fee totals are complete only after the canonical transaction index catches up. Coverage is returned with paginated results.
Metrics retain 30 days; rate history starts when measurements are collected. Historical block activity fills as canonical blocks are indexed.
Pending transactions have no recorded arrival time. The mempool may change between pages.
Unknown orphan transaction bodies cannot be fetched from the active-chain node RPC.
Pool charts retain 30 days of observations and seed only the histories retained by the node. Longer periods have gaps until data accumulates.

The pool payout archive starts with at most 50 pool payouts and 100 payouts per observed miner. It collects new records and does not claim a complete pre-deployment ledger; archived payout statuses are last reported observations.
GPU temperature, power consumption and direct connection health are not exposed by the pool statistics RPC. Worker counts can reset when a device expires after an hour without shares.
